summary: This bill directs the Secretary of the Interior to establish the National Wildlife Refuge System Invasive Species Strike Team Program, creating invasive species strike teams within each region of the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service to prevent, detect, and respond to invasive species on and near National Wildlife Refuge System lands and waters.

scores.thoughts: This bill establishes a program to combat invasive species within and adjacent to National Wildlife Refuge System lands. By eradicating, controlling, and reducing the adverse effects of invasive species, the bill directly aims to conserve and restore native biological communities and habitats, which is a form of environmental protection.
